data.rationale: The proposal follows the same sequence of sites and steps with nearly all the right parameters, but it leaves out the review score of 8 or more filter and the first-result selection, hardcodes the 19:30 slot and the € currency, uses an undefined {name} and {dates}, ends with a vague "save/send or discard" instead of "do not send, click Discard", and omits the "do not click Reserve/Book" guards, so an automation built from it would be somewhat ambiguous and unsafe.
